violated_contract: Home must not publish capture fragments or provisional titles as settled content while episode membership and summary authority are still arriving. Hiding a member requires a reachable replacement held by that client.
canonical_prevention: Apply shared settling and neutral-title projections at the backend read boundary, require an exact client-held replacement before member suppression, and schedule compose at close. Contract tests cover expired versus settled floor verdicts, legacy title provenance, output language, close-triggered compose and member reachability.
